Dear [Miss Phillpotts](../persons.html#1171),
It seems hardly fair to have kept your paper several days, when the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) is obliged to 'draw a line' against the numerous Missionary Papers it might have, but I wanted to show it to [Miss Crawley](../persons.html#382) - who you know, as well as [Miss Morshead](../persons.html#28) was one of the first Sisters.

She begged to keep a copy of it, and I think it would be most advisable to publish it. I was thinking of sending it to the [Literary Churchman](../others.html#76)

Yours truly

C M Yonge
Looking again at your note I see you design it for the [Net ](../others.html#94)as the next choice, so here it is.
